module: Flowgraph node "Create Vehicle Pool" (once_instant). Creates a vehicle pool (core_vehicleActivePooling.createPool({name})) to manage the activation/deactivation of vehicle objects; output vehPool. Option data.keepVehicles ("Keep Inactive Vehicles"): when the pool is deleted, keeps the inactive vehicles (deletePool(keepVehicles)).

onNodeReset.desc: Deletes the created pool (deletePool) and forgets it.

workOnce.desc: Creates the pool if it does not exist and publishes it on vehPool.
